author: Beth Nor
title: Disappointed
body:
[!TL;DR] I strongly advise against using this AI powered workspace application. I loved and used Notion for years (despite certain limitations), but the egregious pivot toward an AI focused identity has become incredibly detrimental to the overall user experience.
___
Notion was initially a workspace I loved and used extensively (for work/academics/personal) for years. However, their decision to push numerous incredibly *intrusive* AI features on top of replacing essential UI components with AI toggles, have really left me with immense frustration. Their identity has become almost entirely focused toward AI while neglecting their core pre-existing features. I often used to recommend/introduce others to Notion (including the agency I prev worked at), and even built templates for these individuals and businesses. I am incredibly disappointed in what it’s become and am actively transitioning to an alternative system. Personally, this app and its team are no longer worth supporting considering their intense love for such an inhumane system of AI implementation, and  consistent disregard for its user experience.

title: Good app, extremely laggy on iPhone
body:
Been using Notion for years, I love the app, and though it takes some time to understand how it all works once you do it’s simple and fun to utilize. 

With that said the app is really really laggy on iPhone. 

A few issues I’ve found using Notion on iPhone:  

1. I cannot delete text on the app. Say I select text and press the x button to delete it on my iPhone keyboard, it will not delete. Even if I press x to delete it without selecting the text it won’t delete so I have to select and press the ‘cut’ selection.

2. Certain pages won’t load when I try to open them, it’ll display the loading icon for awhile and then seemingly crash and close the app.

3. Inserting photos and the page auto-scrolls downwards to the end of the page. Pretty self explanatory, but when I insert photos and then try to move them around the page it’ll start auto scrolling to the bottom of the page. 

4. The app freezing. Sometimes it just freezes and I have to close the app and reopen it. 

5. Accidentally selecting an item (like a divider) and the app won’t let me close the menu that pops up after where the ‘insert below’ option shows up. 


These are just a few issues I’ve found while using the app on iPhone. I truly do love the app, I just don’t like that these issues are so frequent. 

(side note: i have deleted and reinstalled the app in the hopes of fixing these glitches, but it doesn’t fix them.)

title: Notion is NOT okay (updated review)
body:
The app is incredibly buggy. Transitioning from my laptop to my phone is such a painful experience. The Notion app is riddled with glitches and bugs. This wasn’t an issue before, I could move multi-select options whenever, so why is it happening now? I can’t help but feel like the effort put into maintaining the user experience in the desktop version, whilst adding in new features, isn’t being applied to the app version, which is very disappointing. Creating a great platform for team communication and personal organization, only to have the app’s experience be so glitchy and frustrating, is disheartening. I love Notion and what it has helped me accomplish, but please, take better care of the app. It’s a shame to see so many bugs crawling around such a nice app. 😞

I’ve tried Trello, asana, and a few others for project management and tracking my life, but Notion is the hub for my small business CRM, my personal calendar and goal tracking, it holds the list for the books I want to read, all of my budgets, all of my tasks. author: Nerdy Pete
title: Each update fixes some breaks others
body:
The latest update left my iPhone 12 Pro Max unable to let me to change the cover image. The change cover page crashes just as the change cover page appears.

Previous review:
Just noticed that I, a paying Notion Plus subscriber can no longer use Notion AI.  Welp, I’m definitely not going to use Notion AI now that I have to upgrade and pay more than 4 times what I normally pay yearly.  And you can’t turn it off or even hide it!  Everyone knows AI is very flawed and yet these tech companies want to charge so much for it!  And anyone who uses Notion knows how flawed it is, which makes it all the more frustrating.  It’s got a truly great structure to it making it incredibly versatile, but it’s like a plane with small wings and no engines.  But hey, you can pay for a somewhat dim flight attendant.

OK, this is my previous review:

Just updated the app, sad to see image files load but then turn white and require me to scroll back up and then over the images to get them to show. Every time I load the page with images in it I have to scroll up and down again. The white screen may not seem like much but it’s annoying in dim light or when updating a journal in bed at night with the lights out. Been using Notion for 8 months now and am kind of surprised this hasn’t been fixed yet.

My original review: it really needs a few things—most importantly, encryption for us poor folks. It looks like you have to be an enterprise customer to get anything resembling actual privacy and it’s unclear what you get is encryption. We live in a time where our data is making people tons of money. I’d rather they not make money off of my notes and my used habits. Also, this needs the same notes graph/map/diagram thingy that a few Notion competitors have that allows you to visualize how all of your notes are related to each other. It is such a cool and helpful way to see the big picture on your projects! The third thing I think it needs is just a slightly better UI. It does a lot but it can be pretty challenging to navigate/find everything. I haven’t checked yet but I suspect that YouTube is the user’s friend along these lines. Otherwise, Notion is a fricken Swiss Army Knife app—you can literally keep a journal, a journal within a journal, a wiki, multiple wikis, I can’t even list all the templates this thing has. It’s really nuts how much you can do with Notion! I just wish it had encryption and the other couple things it’s competition has.

author: SamediSam222
title: AI might be good for some, but for me it was the end.
body:
Years ago, I was recommended this note tool via word of mouth. I initially loved it! Being able to switch between devices as I needed was a big plus for my writing, and I loved the stacking folders and clean ui. 

I had no need for ai when it launched. It was unobtrusive, however, so I carried on. Then, a badly implemented update caused a piece of writing I had worked on for hours to, with an easy keyboard stumble, be completely rewritten. Completely. Hours of work chewed up and spit out into slush. :/ I promptly closed the app and stopped writing in it.  

Years later, I have found a software I like better, with no intrusive ai and no cloud services, so my notes are no longer at risk in a server I don't have access to. I have zero faith that notion has kept anything I ever wrote secure. They continue to say one thing and do another. I am done. 

In logging in to transfer my notes, I notice that the program is buggy and slow in ways it never was years ago. Buffers like crazy. It's actually kind of heartbreaking to see how far this app has fallen.

There are better options out there, with more security and better customization. Even if you want ai in a notes app, there are more clean and helpful options that do not compromise your experience. Why pick notion? I never will again.
